LanguageData.SE_UI_Priority: A usable prepared serum is preferred when its additional materials are available. Otherwise, raw materials are used. Hover to pause; use > to browse.
LanguageData.SE_Regenesis_AdvancedResult: Restore a missing part, or repair a permanent injury
LanguageData.SE_Regenesis_ResultDesc: At natural coma expiry, a random eligible condition is treated. No refund is given if nothing is eligible. Missing parts are restored only by the advanced serum; existing implants are protected.
LanguageData.SE_Neuro_InvalidPatient: Requires a living biological patient with skills.
LanguageData.SE_Neuro_NoEligible: No eligible skill can gain a major passion. Existing stronger or special passions and trait/gene restrictions are respected.
LanguageData.SE_Neuro_Gained: {PAWN_nameDef} has developed a major passion for {1}.
LanguageData.SE_Neuro_Wasted: The neuroplastic treatment had no effect on {PAWN_nameDef}: no suitable skill remained.
LanguageData.SE_Neuro_NormalResult: A random skill becomes a major passion
LanguageData.SE_Neuro_AdvancedResult: The chosen skill becomes a major passion
LanguageData.SE_Neuro_ResultDesc: At natural coma expiry an eligible skill gains a major passion; its level never changes. The basic serum picks randomly, preferring skills without passion or with apathy. The advanced serum asks for a skill before use. Existing major, stronger and special passions are protected; trait and gene restrictions are respected. If no eligible skill remains when treatment ends, the dose is wasted.
